name: feishu
description: Send Kettu notices to Feishu or Lark. Posts the notices you pick to a group as message cards, through a custom bot.

description.en: Send Kettu notices to Feishu or Lark. Posts the notices you pick to a group as message cards, through a custom bot.
description.zh-CN: 通过自定义机器人，把你选的 Kettu 通知以消息卡片发到飞书或 Lark 的群里。

settings.title: Webhook address
settings.description: The address of the group's custom bot, from open.feishu.cn or open.larksuite.com. Anyone who has it can post to the group, so it is kept in the key store.

settings.title: Signature secret (optional)
settings.description: Only if you turned on signature verification for the bot.

settings.title: Keyword (optional)
settings.description: Only if the bot requires a keyword. It is put in front of each card's title when the title lacks it.

description.en: Notices posted as cards to your group. They are not answered from there.
description.zh-CN: 以卡片发到你的群里的通知，不能在群里回答。

description.en: Where notices go, and a test card.
description.zh-CN: 通知发到哪里，以及测试卡片。

title.en: Send a test card to Feishu or Lark
title.zh-CN: 向飞书或 Lark 发送测试卡片
